style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website for elementary students in Taiwan. Landscape 3:2. Setting: present-day Taiwan (Taiwanese schools, streets, homes, parks). Taiwanese school uniform = plain polo shirt or white shirt with shorts/skirt, or sports PE uniform; NO red neckerchief, NO red scarf. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, paper texture visible. Restrained natural grass green, pale sky blue, warm earthy brown, generous ivory breathing room; no bright flat digital colors, no glossy 3D, no imitation of a named artist. Every person has five fingers per hand, arms clearly attached to shoulders, feet grounded and pointing naturally. scene_prompt: 胸有成竹 means having a thoroughly prepared plan and confidence before acting. Modern older child confidently assembles a small wooden birdhouse at a craft table using harmless wood glue. A COMPLETE, detailed visual blueprint of that SAME birdhouse lies OPEN next to the work, with all wood pieces neatly laid out in assembly order; partially assembled birdhouse already fits together accurately. Child looks calmly certain, knowing next step, not surprised or improvising. A faint pencil thought bubble shows the fully finished matching birdhouse, indicating the whole result is clear in mind. No writing, dimensions or numbers on diagram, only shapes. No power tools, knives, injury, trophies or money. Focus on prepared confidence.
